_comment: DSpark drafter for the variable-loop checkpoint inkling-2-mini-varloop (thinkingmachines/TML-d24-varloop-research, R = 3 passes, per-pass KV). The recipe is that of configs/drafter/inkling-2-mini.json; the target, its traces and the drafter are this model's own (a drafter trained on Inkling-2-Mini's features is not this model's drafter). Pass --traces, --out; --micro-blocks 128 on an 80 GB card.
